caption: The drawing is composed primarily in grayscale tones and features a central, ornate cross with decorative ends and a textured, layered design. The cross is supported by two symmetrical, curved metal supports that extend from its base, which is placed on a rectangular stone or concrete platform. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small, detailed illustration of a decorative architectural or ornamental element with a symmetric, floral motif and vertical bars underneath. The background is sparsely rendered with faint outlines suggesting rooftops and distant structures, as well as a portion of a small fence to the right of the platform. The entire image is contained within a square border on a rectangular sheet, with a neutral, light background.
title: Wrought Iron Cross
